https://thedfirreport.com/2024/02/26/seo.title: SEO Poisoning to Domain Control: The Gootloader Saga Continues
https://thedfirreport.com/2024/02/26/seo.overview: The DFIR Report follows an intrusion that began when a user downloaded a poisoned search result: Gootloader JavaScript fetched a Cobalt Strike payload about nine hours later, and the attacker moved over SMB, WinRM and RDP, used SystemBC as a SOCKS5 tunnel and reached the domain controllers, file shares and backup server.

https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/cair.title: Attackers Use Autonomous AI to Target Semiconductor, Defense and Civil Society Sectors
https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/cair.overview: Unit 42 describes CL-STA-1238, assessed with moderate confidence as China-nexus, running a customized fork of the open-source Cairn AI penetration-testing framework in 25 operations against at least 19 semiconductor, defense and civil society organizations in August and September 2026. AI agents mapped targets, exploited web applications and identity weaknesses, collected credentials and reached internal networks; the operators supplied extra intelligence such as VPN gateway addresses and shared group passwords.
